words.enDefinition: a large number or amount of something

examples.en: There are a lot of international students in my dorm this semester.
examples.zh: 这学期我宿舍里住着「很多」国际学生。

examples.en: I spent a lot of money on textbooks at the start of term.
examples.zh: 开学时我花了「很多」钱买课本。

words.enDefinition: a large quantity of people or things

examples.en: We got lots of free pizza at the club fair on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五社团招新会上我们拿到了「许多」免费披萨。

examples.en: There are lots of good study spots in the main library.
examples.zh: 主图书馆里有「许多」适合自习的地方。

words.enDefinition: a collection or group of people or things

examples.en: My roommate left a bunch of dirty dishes in the sink again.
examples.zh: 室友又在水槽里留了「一大堆」脏盘子。

examples.en: A bunch of us are going to the movies tonight, want to come?
examples.zh: 今晚我们「一堆」人要去看电影，你要一起吗？

words.enDefinition: a fairly large number of things or people

examples.en: Quite a few students failed the first physics quiz this term.
examples.zh: 这学期「相当多」学生第一次物理测验没及格。

examples.en: I know quite a few people who work at the campus coffee shop.
examples.zh: 我认识「相当多」在校内咖啡店打工的人。

words.enDefinition: an extremely large amount of something

examples.en: Thanks for sending the notes, they saved me tons of time.
examples.zh: 谢谢你发笔记给我，帮我省了「超多」时间。

examples.en: The dining hall has tons of choices during dinner hours.
examples.zh: 晚餐时段食堂有「超多」选择。

words.enDefinition: a very large quantity of something

examples.en: We have loads of reading to finish before Thursday's seminar.
examples.zh: 周四研讨会之前我们有「大量」阅读要完成。

examples.en: My aunt sent me loads of snacks for midterms week.
examples.zh: 期中周阿姨给我寄了「好多」零食。

words.enDefinition: as much or as many as you need

examples.en: Don't rush, we still have plenty of time before the bus arrives.
examples.zh: 别急，公交来之前我们的时间还很「充裕」。

examples.en: There's plenty of space in the fridge for your groceries.
examples.zh: 冰箱里的空间很「充裕」，放得下你买的菜。

words.enDefinition: a large number, in multiples of twelve

examples.en: Dozens of students lined up outside the bookstore on the first day.
examples.zh: 开学第一天「几十个」学生在书店门口排队。

examples.en: I've applied to dozens of internships since the semester started.
examples.zh: 这学期开始以来，我已经投了「几十个」实习申请。

words.enDefinition: an unspecified very large number

examples.en: Hundreds of people commented on the student council's post overnight.
examples.zh: 一夜之间「数以百计」的人评论了学生会的帖子。

examples.en: The library book sale had hundreds of used textbooks for cheap.
examples.zh: 图书馆旧书特卖上有「数以百计」的廉价二手教材。

words.enDefinition: an extremely large number of things

examples.en: Thousands of fans watched our graduation livestream from home last year.
examples.zh: 去年「数以千计」的观众在家里看了我们的毕业直播。

examples.en: My phone holds thousands of photos from my first year abroad.
examples.zh: 我手机里存着「数以千计」出国第一年拍的照片。

words.enDefinition: an enormous number of people or things

examples.en: Millions of people use this language app to practice every day.
examples.zh: 每天有「数以百万计」的人用这款语言应用练习。

examples.en: The video of our campus flash mob got millions of views.
examples.zh: 我们校园快闪的视频获得了「数以百万计」的播放量。

words.enDefinition: too many to count or list

examples.en: I've watched countless tutorial videos trying to fix my laptop.
examples.zh: 为了修好笔记本，我看了「无数」教学视频。

examples.en: She spent countless hours in the studio rehearsing for the spring concert.
examples.zh: 她在练功房花了「无数」小时为春季音乐会排练。

words.enDefinition: existing in large numbers

examples.en: There are numerous reasons to double-check your flight details before leaving.
examples.zh: 出发前有「众多」理由需要反复核对航班信息。

examples.en: The professor gave numerous examples to make the theory easier to understand.
examples.zh: 教授举了「众多」例子，让理论更容易理解。

words.enDefinition: more than two but not very many

examples.en: I've already asked several classmates about the assignment deadline today.
examples.zh: 今天我已经问过「几个」同学作业的截止时间了。

examples.en: The campus bus stops at several places near the dorms.
examples.zh: 校园班车在宿舍附近的「几个」地方停靠。

words.enDefinition: several; more than a few

examples.en: A number of students complained about the broken printers in the library.
examples.zh: 「若干」学生抱怨图书馆的打印机坏了。

examples.en: We faced a number of problems when setting up the club.
examples.zh: 创办社团的过程中我们遇到了「若干」问题。

words.enDefinition: a large amount of something abstract

examples.en: Writing the thesis took a great deal of time and patience.
examples.zh: 写论文花了「大量」的时间和耐心。

examples.en: She showed a great deal of patience with the new exchange students.
examples.zh: 她对新来的交换生表现出「极大的」耐心。

words.enDefinition: many different kinds of something

examples.en: The gym offers a wide range of classes, from yoga to boxing.
examples.zh: 健身房开设瑜伽、拳击等「种类广泛」的课程。

examples.en: You can borrow a wide range of equipment from the media lab.
examples.zh: 你可以从媒体实验室借到「各种各样」的设备。

words.enDefinition: several different kinds of the same thing

examples.en: The dining hall serves a variety of dishes every week.
examples.zh: 食堂每周供应「各种各样的」菜品。

examples.en: We discussed a variety of topics during the orientation session.
examples.zh: 迎新会上我们讨论了「各种各样的」话题。

words.enDefinition: many different types of people or things

examples.en: You'll meet all kinds of people at an international students' mixer.
examples.zh: 在国际学生联谊会上你会遇到「各式各样的」人。

examples.en: My roommate collects all kinds of snacks from different countries.
examples.zh: 我室友收集了「各式各样的」各国零食。

words.enDefinition: most of the people or things in a group

examples.en: The majority of students take the shuttle to morning classes.
examples.zh: 「大多数」学生坐班车去上早课。

examples.en: The majority of my classmates prefer to submit essays online now.
examples.zh: 现在我的同学「大多数」都更喜欢在线提交论文。

words.enDefinition: a very small number or amount

examples.en: Only a handful of students showed up to the early review session.
examples.zh: 只有「寥寥几个」学生来参加早上的复习课。

examples.en: She grabbed a handful of popcorn before the movie started.
examples.zh: 电影开始前她抓了「一把」爆米花。

words.enDefinition: two, or a small number of things

examples.en: I'll be there in a couple of minutes, order me a latte.
examples.zh: 我「两三分钟」就到，帮我点一杯拿铁。

examples.en: We watched a couple of episodes after dinner last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚饭后我们看了「两三集」剧。

words.enDefinition: a small amount of something

examples.en: Can I give you a bit of advice about professor office hours?
examples.zh: 关于教授答疑时间，我能给你「一点」建议吗？

examples.en: There's still a bit of milk left in the mini fridge.
examples.zh: 小冰箱里还剩「一点」牛奶。

words.enDefinition: a fairly large amount of something

examples.en: I saved quite a bit of money by cooking instead of eating out.
examples.zh: 自己做饭而不下馆子，我省了「不少」钱。

examples.en: She travels quite a bit for her part-time marketing job.
examples.zh: 因为兼职做市场工作，她要跑「不少」地方。

words.enDefinition: a very small part of a whole

examples.en: Rent here costs a fraction of what you'd pay downtown.
examples.zh: 这里的房租只是市中心价格的「一小部分」。

examples.en: Only a fraction of applicants get into that summer program.
examples.zh: 只有「一小部分」申请者能进那个暑期项目。

words.enDefinition: an extremely small amount, almost zero

examples.en: I bought this secondhand bike for next to nothing at a yard sale.
examples.zh: 我在庭院旧货集市上「几乎没花钱」就买下了这辆二手自行车。

examples.en: The club charges next to nothing for its weekly yoga classes.
examples.zh: 社团的每周瑜伽课收费「几乎为零」。

words.enDefinition: a situation where not enough of something exists

examples.en: There's a shortage of parking spots near the science building.
examples.zh: 理科教学楼附近「停车位短缺」。

examples.en: The cafe hired extra staff because of a shortage of workers.
examples.zh: 因为「人手短缺」，咖啡店多招了几名员工。

words.enDefinition: to have very little of something left

examples.en: We're running low on laundry detergent, add it to the shopping list.
examples.zh: 我们的洗衣液「快用完了」，把它加进购物清单吧。

examples.en: My meal plan funds are running low before the end of term.
examples.zh: 学期结束前，我的餐费余额就「快用完了」。

words.enDefinition: two things used or seen together

examples.en: I need a pair of comfortable shoes for walking around campus.
examples.zh: 我需要「一双」舒服的鞋在校园里走动。

examples.en: She bought a pair of gloves before the first snowfall.
examples.zh: 初雪来临前她买了「一双」手套。

words.enDefinition: a single amount of something larger

examples.en: Can I have a piece of that banana bread you baked?
examples.zh: 你烤的香蕉面包能给我「一块」吗？

examples.en: He tore a piece of paper to write down the Wi-Fi password.
examples.zh: 他撕了「一张」纸记下无线网密码。

words.enDefinition: a thin flat piece cut from something

examples.en: Would you like a slice of pizza before your next class?
examples.zh: 下一节课前要不要来「一片」披萨？

examples.en: She added a slice of lemon to her iced tea.
examples.zh: 她在冰茶里加了「一片」柠檬。

words.enDefinition: a group of similar things belonging together

examples.en: My mom mailed me a set of sheets for my dorm bed.
examples.zh: 妈妈给我寄来了「一套」宿舍床单。

examples.en: The TA handed each group a set of practice questions.
examples.zh: 助教给每组发了「一套」练习题。

words.enDefinition: several similar things happening one after another

examples.en: The career center is hosting a series of resume workshops this month.
examples.zh: 就业指导中心本月举办「一系列」简历工作坊。

examples.en: A series of delays made me miss my connecting flight.
examples.zh: 「一系列」延误害我错过了转机航班。

words.enDefinition: several people or things considered together

examples.en: A group of us studies together in the library every Tuesday.
examples.zh: 每周二我们「一群」人在图书馆一起学习。

examples.en: A group of tourists asked me for directions to the museum.
examples.zh: 「一群」游客向我打听去博物馆的路。

words.enDefinition: the amount a cup holds

examples.en: Let's grab a cup of coffee before our morning lecture.
examples.zh: 早课之前我们去喝「一杯」咖啡吧。

examples.en: He made me a cup of hot chocolate when I was stressed.
examples.zh: 我压力大的时候，他给我泡了「一杯」热巧克力。

words.enDefinition: the amount a bottle holds

examples.en: Bring a bottle of water to the gym, it gets hot in there.
examples.zh: 去健身房带「一瓶」水吧，里面很热。

examples.en: I left a bottle of soda in the freezer by mistake.
examples.zh: 我不小心把「一瓶」汽水忘在了冷冻室。

words.enDefinition: one of two equal parts of something

examples.en: Half of my floor went home for the long weekend.
examples.zh: 长周末我楼层「一半」的人都回家了。

examples.en: I spent half of my monthly paycheck on winter boots already.
examples.zh: 买雪地靴已经花掉了我月薪的「一半」。

words.enDefinition: not one of a group of people or things

examples.en: None of the vending machines on this floor take cash.
examples.zh: 这一层的自动售货机「一台都不」收现金。

examples.en: None of my roommates wanted to split the delivery fee.
examples.zh: 我的室友们「谁也不」想分摊外送费。

words.enDefinition: what remains after the part already mentioned

examples.en: You finish the slides and I'll handle the rest of the presentation.
examples.zh: 你把幻灯片做完，报告的「其余部分」我来处理。

examples.en: The rest of my family is flying in for graduation.
examples.zh: 我家的「其他人」会飞过来参加毕业典礼。

words.enDefinition: each one without any exception

examples.en: I checked every single one of the clauses before signing the lease.
examples.zh: 签租约之前，「每一个」条款我都核对过了。

examples.en: Every single one of my professors posts grades online now.
examples.zh: 现在我「每一位」教授都在网上公布成绩。

words.enDefinition: first one, then the next, then the next

examples.en: The new club members introduced themselves one by one at the meeting.
examples.zh: 新社员在会上「一个接一个」地自我介绍。

examples.en: We checked the applicants' names one by one against the list.
examples.zh: 我们把申请者的名字「逐一」和名单核对了一遍。

words.enDefinition: remaining after other parts have been eaten or used

examples.en: We made fried rice with the leftover chicken from last night.
examples.zh: 我们用昨晚「剩下的」鸡肉做了炒饭。

examples.en: Put the leftover pizza in the fridge before you leave.
examples.zh: 出门前把「剩下的」披萨放进冰箱。

words.enDefinition: as much as is needed

examples.en: I didn't bring enough cash for the laundry machines downstairs.
examples.zh: 我带的现金「不够」用楼下的洗衣机。

examples.en: Two pillows and one blanket are enough for me, thanks.
examples.zh: 两个枕头加一床毯子对我来说就「足够」了，谢谢。

words.enDefinition: less than the amount needed

examples.en: There's not enough space in the microwave for two lunch boxes.
examples.zh: 微波炉的空间「不够」，放不下两个饭盒。

examples.en: I skipped breakfast because there was not enough time before class.
examples.zh: 上课前时间「不够」，我没来得及吃早餐。

words.enDefinition: more than is needed or wanted

examples.en: I spent too much time scrolling on my phone last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我刷手机刷了「太多」时间。

examples.en: There's too much sugar in the boba from that new shop.
examples.zh: 那家新店的奶茶含糖「太多」了。

words.enDefinition: a larger number than is needed

examples.en: There are too many people waiting for the elevator at noon.
examples.zh: 正午电梯口等着的人「太多」了。

examples.en: I signed up for too many clubs and my schedule is packed.
examples.zh: 我这学期报的社团「太多」，课表全排满了。

words.enDefinition: more than the amount that is needed

examples.en: The meal plan gives us more than enough food each week.
examples.zh: 餐食计划给我们的食物每周都「绰绰有余」。

examples.en: Two hundred dollars is more than enough for the weekend trip.
examples.zh: 两百美元周末出游「绰绰有余」。

words.enDefinition: a large number, used for emphasis

examples.en: There are so many events on campus during welcome week.
examples.zh: 迎新周校园里有「这么多」活动。

examples.en: Why are there so many people in the gym at seven a.m.?
examples.zh: 为什么早上七点健身房有「这么多」人？

words.enDefinition: to some degree; fairly

examples.en: The campus gym is quite crowded right after five p.m.
examples.zh: 下午五点过后，健身房「相当」拥挤。

examples.en: Her presentation was quite impressive for someone so new to debating.
examples.zh: 对辩论新手来说，她的表现「相当」出色。

words.enDefinition: to a noticeable degree; fairly

examples.en: The walk to the far lecture hall is rather long in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天走去远端教学楼的路「颇为」漫长。

examples.en: I found the reading list for this course rather confusing at first.
examples.zh: 起初我觉得这门课的阅读清单「颇为」费解。

words.enDefinition: almost completely; nearly

examples.en: I've finished pretty much all of my assignments for this week.
examples.zh: 这周的作业我「基本上」全写完了。

examples.en: The two phone plans cost pretty much the same per month.
examples.zh: 这两个手机套餐每月费用「基本一样」。

words.enDefinition: to an unusually great degree

examples.en: The professor's feedback on my first draft was incredibly helpful.
examples.zh: 教授对我初稿的反馈「极其」有帮助。

examples.en: That new study lounge gets incredibly loud during finals week.
examples.zh: 期末周那间新自习室会变得「极其」吵闹。

words.enDefinition: completely, without any doubt

examples.en: After the all-nighter, I felt utterly exhausted in my morning class.
examples.zh: 熬完夜，早课上我「完全」筋疲力尽。

examples.en: His phone died, leaving him utterly lost without the campus map.
examples.zh: 手机没电后，没有校园地图的他「完全」迷失了方向。

words.enDefinition: to a small, gentle degree

examples.en: I was mildly annoyed when my printer ran out of ink again.
examples.zh: 打印机又没墨了，我「略微」有点恼火。

examples.en: The soup was only mildly spicy, perfect for a cold evening.
examples.zh: 汤只是「略微」有点辣，很适合寒冷的夜晚。

words.enDefinition: neither very much nor very little

examples.en: The campus doctor told me to exercise moderately for a few weeks.
examples.zh: 校医让我接下来几周「适度」运动。

examples.en: The apartment near campus is moderately priced for this neighborhood.
examples.zh: 校园附近的公寓在这个街区价格「适中」。

words.enDefinition: in an extreme and sudden way

examples.en: Bus fares dropped drastically after the city's new transport policy.
examples.zh: 新交通政策出台后，公交票价「大幅」下降。

examples.en: My study habits changed drastically after I joined the study group.
examples.zh: 加入学习小组后，我的学习习惯发生了「巨大」改变。

words.enDefinition: a very small amount, informal

examples.en: The dorm room feels a tad small with three desks in it.
examples.zh: 放进三张书桌后，宿舍房间显得「稍微」小了点。

examples.en: Your coffee is a tad too sweet for me, honestly.
examples.zh: 说实话，你的咖啡对我来说「稍微」甜了点。

words.enDefinition: much more than is acceptable

examples.en: The lecture hall is way too cold, bring a hoodie tomorrow.
examples.zh: 梯教室里「实在太」冷了，明天带件连帽衫。

examples.en: That assignment took way too long for only ten percent of the grade.
examples.zh: 那份作业只占总成绩百分之十，花的时间却「实在」太长。

words.enDefinition: much more than is desirable

examples.en: The auditorium gets far too noisy for studying during lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐时间的礼堂「过于」嘈杂，没法学习。

examples.en: He spends far too much money on food delivery every month.
examples.zh: 他每月花在外卖上的钱「过于」多了。

words.enDefinition: almost none at all

examples.en: There was barely any hot water left after eight a.m.
examples.zh: 早上八点过后，热水就「几乎没有」了。

examples.en: I made barely any progress on my essay this weekend.
examples.zh: 这个周末我的论文「几乎没」什么进展。

words.enDefinition: only just; almost not

examples.en: My desk lamp is so dim that I can hardly see my notes.
examples.zh: 台灯太暗了，我「几乎」看不清笔记。

examples.en: He hardly talks in seminars, but his essays are brilliant.
examples.zh: 他在研讨课上「几乎不」发言，但论文写得很出色。

words.enDefinition: to some degree but not completely

examples.en: I'm kind of nervous about presenting in front of the whole class.
examples.zh: 要在全班面前做展示，我「有点儿」紧张。

examples.en: The new cafeteria food is kind of bland this week.
examples.zh: 这周食堂的新菜「有点儿」寡淡。

words.enDefinition: in some way but not exactly

examples.en: The movie was sort of boring, but the popcorn was great.
examples.zh: 电影「有点」无聊，不过爆米花很好吃。

examples.en: I sort of promised my roommate I'd clean the bathroom today.
examples.zh: 我「算是」答应过室友今天打扫卫生间。

words.enDefinition: very nearly but not completely

examples.en: I almost missed the shuttle because I overslept this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上我睡过头，「差点儿」错过班车。

examples.en: The line at the bookstore was almost out the door.
examples.zh: 书店的队伍「几乎」排到了门外。

words.enDefinition: approximately, close to an exact number

examples.en: The party starts around eight, so don't stress about being exact.
examples.zh: 派对「大约」八点开始，不用太掐点。

examples.en: Each of the big lecture halls seats around two hundred students.
examples.zh: 每间大梯教室「大约」能坐两百名学生。

words.enDefinition: approximately, used after a number

examples.en: The walk from the dorm to class takes ten minutes or so.
examples.zh: 从宿舍走到教室需要「十分钟左右」。

examples.en: Stay for another hour or so before you head back.
examples.zh: 回去之前再待「一个来小时」吧。

words.enDefinition: allowing a small amount of error

examples.en: The flight takes nine hours, give or take, depending on the wind.
examples.zh: 航程九小时「上下」，视风向略有出入。

examples.en: There were fifty people at the party, give or take a few.
examples.zh: 派对上「五十人上下」，差不了几个。

words.enDefinition: nearly, very close to completely

examples.en: I've just about finished packing for the move to the new dorm.
examples.zh: 搬去新宿舍的行李我「差不多」收拾完了。

examples.en: The bus was just about to leave when I got there.
examples.zh: 我赶到的时候，公交「眼看」就要开了。

words.enDefinition: almost; near a number or state

examples.en: My new apartment is close to both campus and the grocery store.
examples.zh: 我的新公寓「离校园和超市都很近」。

examples.en: We're close to finishing the group project, just one slide left.
examples.zh: 小组项目「快」完成了，只剩一页幻灯片。

words.enDefinition: approximately; to some degree

examples.en: The two dorms cost more or less the same per month.
examples.zh: 这两栋宿舍每月的费用「大致」相同。

examples.en: I've more or less decided to take the morning economics class.
examples.zh: 我「基本」决定选早上的经济学课了。

words.enDefinition: as many or as much as a limit

examples.en: The study room fits up to eight people at one time.
examples.zh: 这间自习室「最多能容纳」八个人。

examples.en: You can borrow up to six books with your student card.
examples.zh: 用学生证你一次「最多」可以借六本书。

words.enDefinition: no less than; not fewer than

examples.en: You should arrive at least fifteen minutes before the exam starts.
examples.zh: 考试开始前你「至少」要提前十五分钟到。

examples.en: Call your parents at least once a week while you're abroad.
examples.zh: 在国外也要「至少」每周给父母打一次电话。

words.enDefinition: no more than a stated amount

examples.en: The taxi ride takes twenty minutes at most without traffic.
examples.zh: 不堵车的话，打车「顶多」二十分钟。

examples.en: There are at most four spots left in that workshop.
examples.zh: 那个工作坊「最多」还剩四个名额。

words.enDefinition: only; a maximum of

examples.en: The essay should be no more than two pages long.
examples.zh: 这篇论文「不超过」两页。

examples.en: It's no more than a five-minute walk to the dining hall.
examples.zh: 去食堂走路「不过」五分钟。

words.enDefinition: usually or typically, based on calculations

examples.en: Students here spend on average two hours a day in the library.
examples.zh: 这里的学生「平均」每天在图书馆待两个小时。

examples.en: We spend on average sixty dollars a week on groceries.
examples.zh: 我们「平均」每周花六十美元买食材。

words.enDefinition: when everything is added together

examples.en: In total, my textbooks cost three hundred dollars this term.
examples.zh: 这学期课本「总共」花了三百美元。

examples.en: There were twelve of us in total at the study session.
examples.zh: 参加自习的人「总共」有十二个。

words.enDefinition: very small in amount or degree

examples.en: There was minimal damage to my laptop after the small spill.
examples.zh: 打翻水之后，我的笔记本只受到「极小」的损坏。

examples.en: The move to the new dorm required minimal packing supplies.
examples.zh: 搬去新宿舍只需要「极少量」的打包用品。

words.enDefinition: extremely large in size, amount or degree

examples.en: There is a massive difference between high school and college grading.
examples.zh: 高中和大学的评分方式差别「巨大」。

examples.en: The library has a massive collection of online journals now.
examples.zh: 图书馆现在有「庞大」的在线期刊馆藏。

words.enDefinition: extremely small in size or amount

examples.en: Our kitchen is tiny, but we still manage to cook together.
examples.zh: 我们的厨房「极小」，但大家还是能一起做饭。

examples.en: There's a tiny cafe two blocks from the dorm that I love.
examples.zh: 宿舍两条街外有家「小小的」咖啡馆，我很喜欢。

words.enDefinition: not easy to find because there is little

examples.en: Study rooms are scarce during finals week, so book ahead.
examples.zh: 期末周自习室很「紧缺」，所以要提前预订。

examples.en: Cheap apartments near campus are scarce this time of year.
examples.zh: 每年这个时候，校园附近的便宜公寓都很「稀缺」。

words.enDefinition: of the same quality as something else

examples.en: The campus clinic's service is as good as any hospital's downtown.
examples.zh: 校医院的服务「不比市中心的医院差」。

examples.en: My repaired phone screen looks as good as new now.
examples.zh: 修好的手机屏幕现在看起来「跟新的一样」。

words.enDefinition: an equal amount compared with something

examples.en: I don't earn as much as my roommate at the same job.
examples.zh: 同样的工作，我挣得「没有室友多」。

examples.en: I don't snack as much as my desk-mate does during finals.
examples.zh: 期末周我吃零食「没有同桌那么多」。

words.enDefinition: the greatest amount you can manage

examples.en: Practice speaking English as much as possible before the oral exam.
examples.zh: 口语考试前要「尽可能多」地练习英语口语。

examples.en: We walked as much as possible to save money on the trip.
examples.zh: 旅行时我们「尽量多」走路来省钱。

words.enDefinition: double the amount of something

examples.en: The campus bookstore charges twice as much for the same calculator.
examples.zh: 同样的计算器，校内书店的售价是「两倍」。

examples.en: I drink twice as much water now that I carry a bottle.
examples.zh: 自从随身带水瓶，我的饮水量「翻了一倍」。

words.enDefinition: clearly the most or best

examples.en: This dorm is by far the quietest one on campus.
examples.zh: 这栋宿舍「显然是」校园里最安静的。

examples.en: The library is by far my favorite place to study.
examples.zh: 图书馆「毫无疑问」是我最爱去自习的地方。

words.enDefinition: not at all close to being something

examples.en: The results were far from perfect, but I passed the course.
examples.zh: 结果「远非」完美，但我通过了这门课。

examples.en: My Spanish is far from fluent after just one semester.
examples.zh: 才学了一个学期，我的西班牙语「远谈不上」流利。

words.enDefinition: much less than the stated amount or level

examples.en: My budget is nowhere near enough for an apartment downtown.
examples.zh: 我的预算「远不够」在市中心租房。

examples.en: The shuttle stop is nowhere near as close as the map showed.
examples.zh: 班车站「远不如」地图上显示的那么近。

words.enDefinition: instead of the thing mentioned

examples.en: I take the stairs rather than wait for the crowded elevator.
examples.zh: 我走楼梯「而不是」去等拥挤的电梯。

examples.en: We cooked at home rather than eating out this weekend.
examples.zh: 这个周末我们在家做饭，「没」下馆子。

words.enDefinition: in place of someone or something

examples.en: Instead of taking the bus, I biked to campus today.
examples.zh: 今天我骑车去学校，「而不是」坐公交。

examples.en: You can use honey instead of sugar in that recipe.
examples.zh: 那道食谱里你可以用蜂蜜「代替」糖。

words.enDefinition: exactly like another thing

examples.en: My new schedule is the same as my roommate's this term.
examples.zh: 这学期我的课表和室友「一模一样」。

examples.en: Is the dining hall menu the same as last year's?
examples.zh: 食堂的菜单和去年「一样」吗？

words.enDefinition: alike in appearance, quality or character

examples.en: Her study method is similar to the one our tutor suggested.
examples.zh: 她的学习方法和辅导老师建议的「相似」。

examples.en: This noodle dish tastes similar to the one back home.
examples.zh: 这道面食的味道和家乡的「很像」。

words.enDefinition: when measured or judged against something else

examples.en: Compared to last winter, this season feels surprisingly mild so far.
examples.zh: 与去年冬天「相比」，今年到目前为止暖和得出奇。

examples.en: My cooking skills have improved a lot compared to freshman year.
examples.zh: 与大一时「相比」，我的厨艺进步了很多。

words.enDefinition: at the same level or standard as

examples.en: The food truck's burritos are on par with the restaurant's.
examples.zh: 餐车卖的墨西哥卷和那家餐厅的「不相上下」。

examples.en: Our department's labs are on par with any top university's.
examples.zh: 我们系的实验室「不输」任何顶尖大学。

words.enDefinition: a larger amount than before or expected

examples.en: The second exam was even more difficult than the first one.
examples.zh: 第二次考试比第一次「还要」难。

examples.en: Thanks! Now I'm even more excited about the study abroad program.
examples.zh: 谢谢！现在我对这个交换项目「更」期待了。

words.enDefinition: an amount that keeps increasing

examples.en: More and more students are using the bike share program.
examples.zh: 「越来越多」的学生在用共享单车。

examples.en: I find myself checking my email more and more these days.
examples.zh: 最近我查邮件「越来越」频繁。

words.enDefinition: an amount that keeps decreasing

examples.en: I eat at the dining hall less and less this semester.
examples.zh: 这学期我去食堂吃饭「越来越少」了。

examples.en: We have less and less free time together before graduation.
examples.zh: 毕业之前，我们的空闲时间「越来越少」。

words.enDefinition: not often; almost never

examples.en: I rarely manage to eat breakfast before my eight a.m. class.
examples.zh: 早八课之前我「很少」来得及吃早餐。

examples.en: The dining hall rarely runs out of pizza on Fridays.
examples.zh: 周五食堂「很少」把披萨卖完。

words.enDefinition: not often; rarely

examples.en: He seldom stays up late because of his morning shifts.
examples.zh: 因为要上早班，他「难得」熬夜。

examples.en: We seldom get snow this early in the semester, enjoy it.
examples.zh: 学期这么早「难得」下雪，好好享受吧。

words.enDefinition: almost never

examples.en: I hardly ever order delivery since I learned to cook.
examples.zh: 学会做饭之后，我「几乎从不」点外卖了。

examples.en: She hardly ever misses her morning swim at the gym.
examples.zh: 她「几乎从不」错过健身房的晨泳。

words.enDefinition: every time; all the time

examples.en: My roommate always leaves a note when she borrows my pan.
examples.zh: 室友借我的锅时「总是」会留张字条。

examples.en: The main library is always packed the week before finals start.
examples.zh: 期末开始前一周，主图书馆「总是」爆满。

words.enDefinition: many times; frequently

examples.en: We often study together at the coffee shop near campus.
examples.zh: 我们「经常」在校门口的咖啡店一起学习。

examples.en: I often skip lunch when my class schedule gets really busy.
examples.zh: 课表一忙，我就「经常」不吃午饭。

words.enDefinition: on some occasions but not all

examples.en: Sometimes I study better with a bit of background music.
examples.zh: 「有时候」我听着背景音乐学习效果更好。

examples.en: The campus shuttle is sometimes late when it rains really hard.
examples.zh: 雨下得很大时，校园班车「有时」会晚点。

words.enDefinition: not at any time; not once

examples.en: My roommate never touches my things without asking me first.
examples.zh: 室友「从不」不经我同意乱动我的东西。

examples.en: I never check my mailbox on Sundays because it's closed.
examples.zh: 周日邮件室不开门，所以我「从不」在周日取信。

words.enDefinition: nearly every time

examples.en: I almost always take the stairs to my third-floor room.
examples.zh: 去三楼的房间，我「几乎总是」走楼梯。

examples.en: Our weekly quiz almost always covers the newest lecture chapter.
examples.zh: 我们的每周小测「几乎总是」考最新讲的章节。

words.enDefinition: continuously or very often

examples.en: My phone dies all the time because the battery is old.
examples.zh: 电池老化，我的手机「动不动」就没电。

examples.en: We used to hang out in the lounge all the time.
examples.zh: 我们以前「一直」泡在休息室里。

words.enDefinition: usually, on most occasions

examples.en: Most of the time I cook dinner with my two roommates.
examples.zh: 「大部分时候」我都和两个室友一起做饭。

examples.en: The gym is empty most of the time on Sunday mornings.
examples.zh: 周日早上健身房「大部分时间」都空着。

collocations: most of the time it works
most of the time I agree
most of the time during the week

words.enDefinition: occasionally, but not regularly

examples.en: I video call my grandparents from time to time on weekends.
examples.zh: 周末我会「偶尔」和祖父母视频通话。

examples.en: The department organizes career talks for students from time to time.
examples.zh: 系里「偶尔」会为学生组织职业讲座。

collocations: check in from time to time
from time to time I still

words.enDefinition: occasionally, at irregular intervals

examples.en: Every so often the cafeteria surprises us with my favorite dumplings.
examples.zh: 食堂「时不时」会端出我最爱的饺子。

examples.en: My roommate and I deep clean the kitchen every so often.
examples.zh: 我和室友「时不时」会把厨房彻底打扫一遍。

words.enDefinition: with one week skipped in between

examples.en: The cleaning crew comes to our floor every other week.
examples.zh: 保洁人员「每隔一周」来我们楼层一次。

examples.en: I visit my aunt in this city every other week.
examples.zh: 我「每两周」看望一次住在本市的姑妈。

words.enDefinition: on some occasions; occasionally

examples.en: At times I miss my mom's home-cooked food more than anything.
examples.zh: 「有时候」我格外想念妈妈做的家常菜。

examples.en: Group work can be stressful at times, but it teaches teamwork.
examples.zh: 小组作业「有时」让人头疼，但能锻炼协作能力。

words.enDefinition: usually; in most cases

examples.en: More often than not, I take the earlier bus to be safe.
examples.zh: 我「多半」会赶早一班车图个安心。

examples.en: More often than not, the dining hall queues are shortest at four.
examples.zh: 食堂排队「多半」在四点时最短。

collocations: more often than not it rains

words.enDefinition: very rarely

examples.en: We go to that fancy restaurant once in a blue moon.
examples.zh: 我们「难得」去一次那家高档餐厅。

examples.en: Once in a blue moon my roommates all get home at the same time.
examples.zh: 我的室友们「难得」同时到家。

collocations: happen once in a blue moon
once in a blue moon we meet
once in a blue moon only

words.enDefinition: in an irregular, intermittent way

examples.en: I've been learning guitar off and on since high school.
examples.zh: 从高中起，我就「断断续续」地学吉他。

examples.en: It rained off and on during our whole campus tour.
examples.zh: 校园参观期间，雨「断断续续」地下着。

words.enDefinition: one or two times only

examples.en: I've been to the new ramen place once or twice this month.
examples.zh: 这个月我去那家新拉面店吃了「一两次」。

examples.en: Honestly, I've overslept only once or twice this whole semester.
examples.zh: 说实话，这学期我睡过头「只有一两次」。

words.enDefinition: one time in each week

examples.en: Our lab section meets once a week on Thursday afternoons.
examples.zh: 我们的实验课「每周一次」，排在周四下午。

examples.en: I do a big grocery run once a week to save time.
examples.zh: 为了省时间，我「每周一次」集中采购食材。

words.enDefinition: two times in each week

examples.en: I go to the campus gym twice a week these days.
examples.zh: 我最近「每周两次」去健身房。

examples.en: The shuttle to the airport runs twice a week during breaks.
examples.zh: 假期期间，去机场的班车「每周两班」。

words.enDefinition: three times every day

examples.en: Take the medicine three times a day after each meal.
examples.zh: 这种药「一天三次」，随餐服用。

examples.en: The campus shuttle passes my stop three times a day.
examples.zh: 校园班车「一天三次」经过我那一站。

collocations: take it three times a day

words.enDefinition: all day and all night without stopping

examples.en: The engineering building has a printer room open twenty-four seven with student card access.
examples.zh: 工学院楼里有一间「全天候」开放的打印室，可以刷学生卡进入。

examples.en: My host family's shop used to stay open twenty-four seven during the busy summer months.
examples.zh: 夏天生意忙的时候，我寄宿家庭的小店以前是「全天候」营业。

words.enDefinition: repeatedly, each day like the one before

examples.en: Day after day, the same lunch queue stretched outside the cafeteria.
examples.zh: 「日复一日」，食堂门口排着同样的长队。

examples.en: He practiced the piano day after day before the recital.
examples.zh: 演出之前，他「日复一日」地练琴。

words.enDefinition: repeatedly, many times over

examples.en: I read my application essay again and again before submitting it.
examples.zh: 提交之前，我把申请文书「反复」读了好几遍。

examples.en: My laptop froze again and again during the online exam.
examples.zh: 在线考试时，我的笔记本「反复」死机。

words.enDefinition: the same thing repeated many times

examples.en: I played the lecture recording over and over to catch every term.
examples.zh: 我「一遍又一遍」地放讲座录音，想听清每个术语。

examples.en: She practiced her presentation over and over in front of the mirror.
examples.zh: 她对着镜子「一遍又一遍」地练习展示。

words.enDefinition: every day, regularly

examples.en: I water the lab plants on a daily basis for my campus job.
examples.zh: 作为校内工作，我「每天」给实验室的植物浇水。

examples.en: We track our expenses on a daily basis in a shared sheet.
examples.zh: 我们在共享表格里「每天」记录开支。

collocations: on a daily basis at work

words.enDefinition: regularly, at fixed intervals

examples.en: The counseling center suggests checking in on a regular basis.
examples.zh: 心理咨询中心建议大家「定期」去聊聊。

examples.en: Our club reviews its budget on a regular basis each semester.
examples.zh: 我们社团每学期都会「定期」审阅预算。

words.enDefinition: gradually, in small steps

examples.en: Little by little, I'm getting used to the campus layout.
examples.zh: 我「一点一点」熟悉起了校园的布局。

examples.en: My spoken English improved little by little through daily small talk.
examples.zh: 通过日常闲聊，我的英语口语「一点一点」进步。

collocations: little by little it gets easier

words.enDefinition: partly, but not completely

examples.en: To some extent, living abroad has made me more independent.
examples.zh: 「某种程度上」，留学让我变得更独立了。

examples.en: His grades dropped to some extent after he started the part-time job.
examples.zh: 开始打工之后，他的成绩「多少」下滑了一些。
